## Code-Review and Validation Mechanisms — `angular/angular` @ `27da7338`

#### 1. Code Ownership — PullApprove (`/.pullapprove.yml`)

Source: [`.pullapprove.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.pullapprove.yml)

- **`version: 3`** PullApprove configuration, with `github_api_version: 'shadow-cat-preview'` to support draft PRs.
- **`author_value: 1`** default across all groups: the PR author's own ownership counts as one implicit approval vote, meaning an owner who authors a PR only needs one external reviewer.
- **`required-minimum-review` group** ([L1367–L1398](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.pullapprove.yml?L1367-L1398)): a catch-all that lists 24 named team members; `request: 0`, `required: 1`, `author_value: 0` — every PR needs at least one non-self review.
- **File-matched groups** (L118–L1273): 30+ named groups keyed on glob patterns over changed file paths. All must be satisfied before PullApprove passes.
- **Elevated requirements on sensitive areas**:
  - `fw-security` ([L693–L718](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.pullapprove.yml?L693-L718)): `request: -1` (request from everyone), `required: 2` approvals.
  - `tooling-cli-shared-api` ([L976–L991](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.pullapprove.yml?L976-991)): guards `packages/compiler-cli/private/tooling.ts` and `packages/localize/tools/index.ts`; `required: 2`, reviewers are the Angular CLI team (`alan-agius4`, `clydin`, `dgp1130`).
  - `public-api` ([L1194–L1224](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.pullapprove.yml?L1194-1224)): guards `goldens/public-api/**`; `request: 3`, `required: 2`. Activates only after all preceding groups are non-pending and non-rejected (uses `*no-groups-above-this-pending` and `*no-groups-above-this-rejected` anchors).
  - `size-tracking` ([L1229–L1250](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.pullapprove.yml?L1229-1250)): same sequencing guards; guards `goldens/size-tracking/**`; `required: 1`.

#### 2. Commit Message Validation

Sources:
- [`.ng-dev/commit-message.mts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.ng-dev/commit-message.mts)
- [`.gitmessage`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.gitmessage)
- [`.husky/commit-msg`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.husky/commit-msg)
- CircleCI `lint` job, step `ng-dev commit-message validate-range` ([config.yml L264](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.circleci/config.yml?L264))

Rules enforced by `@angular/ng-dev`:
- Format: `<type>(<scope>): <summary>` — types are `build|ci|docs|feat|fix|perf|refactor|style|test`.
- Scopes are enumerated in `commit-message.mts` (39 values, e.g. `animations`, `core`, `router`, `migrations`, `ve`, `devtools`).
- Body required for all types except `docs`; minimum 20 characters (`minBodyLength: 20`).
- `maxLineLength: Infinity` (no hard character wrap enforced by the tool, though `.gitmessage` shows a 100-char guide).

Enforcement points:
- **Local pre-commit**: Husky `commit-msg` hook runs `yarn -s ng-dev commit-message pre-commit-validate --file $1`. Failure exits with `0` (warning only, not blocking at the hook level — `set +e` and `exit 0`).
- **CI**: CircleCI `lint` job enforces `ng-dev commit-message validate-range $CI_GIT_BASE_REVISION $CI_GIT_REVISION` — this is a hard CI gate.
- **GitHub Actions `dev-infra.yml`** runs `commit-message-based-labels` action to apply labels derived from commit type/scope ([dev-infra.yml L16–L18](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.github/workflows/dev-infra.yml?L16-L18)).

**Verification query**: Any commit with type `revert` or scope not in the enumerated list would fail `validate-range`. To verify a specific commit: `yarn ng-dev commit-message validate --file <msg-file>`.

Sources:

Three formatters configured:
- **`clang-format`**: all `**/*.{js,ts}`, excluding `aio/**`, `integration/**`, `third_party/**`, `.yarn/**`, `*.d.ts`, compliance test cases, generated locale files, and `dev-infra/ng-dev.js`.
- **`prettier`**: `**/*.{yaml,yml}` only.
- **`buildifier`**: all Bazel files (`true` shorthand enables default glob).

Enforcement:

- **CI**: `lint` job step: `yarn -s ng-dev format changed $CI_GIT_BASE_REVISION --check` ([config.yml L260](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.circleci/config.yml?L260)) — hard CI gate.

**Verification query**: `yarn ng-dev format changed <base-sha> --check` on any branch tip reveals unformatted files.

#### 4. Static Analysis / Linting

Sources:
- [`tslint.json`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/tslint.json)
- CircleCI `lint` job ([config.yml L252–L266](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.circleci/config.yml?L252-L266))

TSLint rules in use (custom rules in `tools/tslint/`):
- `require-internal-with-underscore`: internal members must use underscore prefix.
- `no-implicit-override-abstract`: explicit `override` required.

CI runs `yarn -s tslint` and `yarn -s --cwd aio lint` as part of the `lint` job.

Also in the `lint` job:
- `yarn -s ts-circular-deps:check`: compares live circular dependencies against the golden file [`goldens/circular-deps/packages.json`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/goldens/circular-deps/packages.json).
- `yarn -s ng-dev pullapprove verify`: validates the PullApprove config itself.
- `yarn -s ng-dev ngbot verify`: validates the Angular bot config.
- `yarn -s check-tooling-setup`: sanity-checks the local dev tooling.

**Verification query**: `yarn ts-circular-deps:check` exits non-zero if actual cycles exceed or differ from the golden.

#### 5. CI Pipeline — CircleCI

Source: [`.circleci/config.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.circleci/config.yml)

Two workflows:

**`default_workflow`** (runs on all branches except `g3`):

| Job | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `setup` | Checkout, Yarn install, Bazel cache warm-up, workspace persist |
| `lint` | TSLint, format check, circular-deps, pullapprove verify, commit-message range validate, `check-tooling-setup` |
| `test` | Full Bazel test suite (`yarn test:ci`), 20-min timeout; 2xlarge+ executor |
| `build-npm-packages` | `yarn build`; persists `dist/packages-dist` |
| `legacy-unit-tests-saucelabs` | Karma via SauceLabs tunnel, legacy bundle |
| `test_aio` | `aio` tests + payload-size check |
| `test_aio_local` | `aio` tests with local-built Angular packages |
| `publish_packages_as_artifacts` | `.tgz` archives for PR artifact download |
| `publish_snapshot` | Publishes to `*-builds` repos — only on `main` or `\d+.\d+.x` branches, gated on `test`, `test_aio_local`, `build-npm-packages`, `legacy-unit-tests-saucelabs` |
| `test_zonejs` | zone.js-specific test suite including closure, electron, Jest |
| `test_win` | Windows CI: compiler-cli build and test via Bazelisk |
| `test_angular_devtools` | DevTools unit tests + Chrome build |
| `deploy_aio` | Deploys angular.io, requires `test_aio` |

**`monitoring`** workflow: scheduled daily at 10:00 AM on `main` only:
- `aio_misc`: tests external URLs in `contributors.json`
- `aio_monitoring_stable`: runs against `https://angular.io/`
- `aio_monitoring_next`: runs against `https://next.angular.io/`
- `saucelabs`: Bazel-based Saucelabs run (not on PRs — too slow)

Failure notifications for monitoring jobs go to two Slack webhooks: `SLACK_CARETAKER_WEBHOOK_URL` and `SLACK_DEV_INFRA_CI_FAILURES_WEBHOOK_URL` ([config.yml L486–L489](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.circleci/config.yml?L486-L489)).

The CI setup job rebases the PR on the target branch before running any job ([config.yml L227–L229](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.circleci/config.yml?L227-L229)), ensuring tests run against the post-merge state.

Bundle size artifacts from the `test` job are stored and consumed by the Angular Robot's `size` plugin (comment in config at L286–L290).

| `dev-infra.yml` | `pull_request_target` (opened/sync/reopen) | (1) Applies commit-message-derived labels; (2) runs `post-approval-changes` check |

All workflow `uses:` action pins include a SHA comment (e.g., `actions/checkout@93ea575cb5d8a053eaa0ac8fa3b40d7e05a33cc8 # tag=v3.1.0`) — supply-chain pinning is universal across workflows.

---

#### 7. Angular Robot (`/.github/angular-robot.yml`)

Source: [`.github/angular-robot.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.github/angular-robot.yml)

**Merge gate** (`merge` plugin): The `action: merge` label activates the merge pipeline. Required preconditions before the label is effective:
- `requireReviews: true` — all requested reviewers must have reviewed.
- `noConflict: true` — no merge conflicts.
- `requiredLabels: ['target: *']` — a target label must be present.
- `forbiddenLabels`: `target: TBD`, `action: cleanup`, `action: review`, `state: blocked`.
- `requiredStatuses`: `ci/circleci: build`, `ci/circleci: lint`, `ci/angular: size`, `google-internal-tests`, `pullapprove`.

**Size plugin**: `maxSizeIncrease: 2000` bytes; sources bundle artifacts from the `ci/circleci: test` job.

**Conflict comment**: auto-comments when a PR has merge conflicts, pinging the PR author.

**Rerun CI**: `action: rerun CI at HEAD` label triggers re-run of the default CircleCI workflow.

#### 8. Golden Files (Generated Artifact Checks)

Source: [`goldens/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/tree/goldens), [`goldens/README.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/goldens/README.md)

Three golden categories, each checked in CI and requiring specific reviewer approval:

| Golden | Check command | Update command | PullApprove group |
|---|---|---|---|
| `goldens/public-api/**` | `yarn public-api:check` | `yarn public-api:update` | `public-api` (2 reviewers required) |
| `goldens/circular-deps/packages.json` | `yarn ts-circular-deps:check` | `yarn ts-circular-deps:approve` | `circular-dependencies` group |
| `goldens/size-tracking/**` | Payload size step in `test_aio` / `test_aio_local` | — | `size-tracking` (1 reviewer required) |

The `public-api` and `size-tracking` groups are additionally sequenced — they only activate once no other PullApprove group is pending or rejected, preventing premature golden approval.

The circular-dep golden encodes **known/accepted cycles** as an allowlist (not a prohibition list). Reduction of cycles updates the golden downward; new cycles not in the golden fail CI.

---

#### 9. PR Merge Configuration (`.ng-dev/pull-request.mts`)

Source: [`.ng-dev/pull-request.mts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.ng-dev/pull-request.mts)

- `githubApiMerge: false` — the ng-dev merge tool uses git-based merging, not the GitHub API squash/merge.
- `requiredBaseCommits`: PRs targeting `main` must be based on commit `5aeb9a4124922d8ac08eb73b8f322905a32b0b3a` (license header update); PRs targeting `10.0.x` must be based on `27b95ba64a5d99757f4042073fd1860e20e3ed24`. This is enforced at merge time.
- `targetLabelExemptScopes: ['dev-infra', 'docs-infra', 'bazel']` — changes scoped to these areas are exempt from patch-branch restriction rules (they can land on patch branches even when they would normally only target `main`).

---

#### 10. Google Internal Sync Gate

Source: [`.ng-dev/google-sync-config.json`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.ng-dev/google-sync-config.json), [`.github/workflows/google-internal-tests.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.github/workflows/google-internal-tests.yml)

Files matching `syncedFilePatterns` (`LICENSE`, `modules/benchmarks/**`, `packages/**`) trigger a `google-internal-tests` required status. Files in `alwaysExternalFilePatterns` (tests, BUILD files, zone.js, markdown, etc.) are excluded from that gate even if they are under `packages/**`.

The `google-internal-tests` status is one of the `requiredStatuses` in the Angular Robot merge gate, so any PR touching synced files cannot be merged until a Googler manually runs the internal presubmit (`go/angular/g3sync`).

- [`.gitmessage`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.gitmessage)
- [`.husky/commit-msg`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.husky/commit-msg)
- CircleCI `lint` job, step `ng-dev commit-message validate-range` ([config.yml L264](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.circleci/config.yml?L264))

Rules enforced by `@angular/ng-dev`:
- Format: `<type>(<scope>): <summary>` — types are `build|ci|docs|feat|fix|perf|refactor|style|test`.
- Scopes are enumerated in `commit-message.mts` (39 values, e.g. `animations`, `core`, `router`, `migrations`, `ve`, `devtools`).
- Body required for all types except `docs`; minimum 20 characters (`minBodyLength: 20`).
- `maxLineLength: Infinity` (no hard character wrap enforced by the tool, though `.gitmessage` shows a 100-char guide).

Enforcement points:
- **Local pre-commit**: Husky `commit-msg` hook runs `yarn -s ng-dev commit-message pre-commit-validate --file $1`. Failure exits with `0` (warning only, not blocking at the hook level — `set +e` and `exit 0`).
- **CI**: CircleCI `lint` job enforces `ng-dev commit-message validate-range $CI_GIT_BASE_REVISION $CI_GIT_REVISION` — this is a hard CI gate.
- **GitHub Actions `dev-infra.yml`** runs `commit-message-based-labels` action to apply labels derived from commit type/scope ([dev-infra.yml L16–L18](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.github/workflows/dev-infra.yml?L16-L18)).

**Verification query**: Any commit with type `revert` or scope not in the enumerated list would fail `validate-range`. To verify a specific commit: `yarn ng-dev commit-message validate --file <msg-file>`.

---

#### 3. Formatting

Sources:
- [`.ng-dev/format.mts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.ng-dev/format.mts)
- [`.clang-format`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.clang-format)
- [`.prettierrc`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.prettierrc)
- [`.husky/pre-commit`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.husky/pre-commit)

Three formatters configured:
- **`clang-format`**: all `**/*.{js,ts}`, excluding `aio/**`, `integration/**`, `third_party/**`, `.yarn/**`, `*.d.ts`, compliance test cases, generated locale files, and `dev-infra/ng-dev.js`.
- **`prettier`**: `**/*.{yaml,yml}` only.
- **`buildifier`**: all Bazel files (`true` shorthand enables default glob).

Enforcement:
- **Local**: Husky `pre-commit` runs `yarn -s ng-dev format staged` (again `set +e; exit 0` — warning only).
- **CI**: `lint` job step: `yarn -s ng-dev format changed $CI_GIT_BASE_REVISION --check` ([config.yml L260](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.circleci/config.yml?L260)) — hard CI gate.

**Verification query**: `yarn ng-dev format changed <base-sha> --check` on any branch tip reveals unformatted files.

---

#### 4. Static Analysis / Linting

Sources:
- [`tslint.json`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/tslint.json)
- CircleCI `lint` job ([config.yml L252–L266](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.circleci/config.yml?L252-L266))

TSLint rules in use (custom rules in `tools/tslint/`):
- `require-internal-with-underscore`: internal members must use underscore prefix.
- `no-implicit-override-abstract`: explicit `override` required.
- `validate-import-for-esm-cjs-interop`: enforces ESM/CJS import compatibility — maintains a `noNamedExports` list of modules that must use default imports (`typescript`, `minimist`, `magic-string`, `semver`, `yargs`, `glob`, etc.).

CI runs `yarn -s tslint` and `yarn -s --cwd aio lint` as part of the `lint` job.

Also in the `lint` job:
- `yarn -s ts-circular-deps:check`: compares live circular dependencies against the golden file [`goldens/circular-deps/packages.json`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/goldens/circular-deps/packages.json).
- `yarn -s ng-dev pullapprove verify`: validates the PullApprove config itself.
- `yarn -s ng-dev ngbot verify`: validates the Angular bot config.
- `yarn -s check-tooling-setup`: sanity-checks the local dev tooling.

**Verification query**: `yarn ts-circular-deps:check` exits non-zero if actual cycles exceed or differ from the golden.

---

#### 5. CI Pipeline — CircleCI

Source: [`.circleci/config.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.circleci/config.yml)

Two workflows:

**`default_workflow`** (runs on all branches except `g3`):

| Job | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `setup` | Checkout, Yarn install, Bazel cache warm-up, workspace persist |
| `lint` | TSLint, format check, circular-deps, pullapprove verify, commit-message range validate, `check-tooling-setup` |
| `test` | Full Bazel test suite (`yarn test:ci`), 20-min timeout; 2xlarge+ executor |
| `build-npm-packages` | `yarn build`; persists `dist/packages-dist` |
| `legacy-unit-tests-saucelabs` | Karma via SauceLabs tunnel, legacy bundle |
| `test_aio` | `aio` tests + payload-size check |
| `test_aio_local` | `aio` tests with local-built Angular packages |
| `publish_packages_as_artifacts` | `.tgz` archives for PR artifact download |
| `publish_snapshot` | Publishes to `*-builds` repos — only on `main` or `\d+.\d+.x` branches, gated on `test`, `test_aio_local`, `build-npm-packages`, `legacy-unit-tests-saucelabs` |
| `test_zonejs` | zone.js-specific test suite including closure, electron, Jest |
| `test_win` | Windows CI: compiler-cli build and test via Bazelisk |
| `test_angular_devtools` | DevTools unit tests + Chrome build |
| `deploy_aio` | Deploys angular.io, requires `test_aio` |

**`monitoring`** workflow: scheduled daily at 10:00 AM on `main` only:
- `aio_misc`: tests external URLs in `contributors.json`
- `aio_monitoring_stable`: runs against `https://angular.io/`
- `aio_monitoring_next`: runs against `https://next.angular.io/`
- `saucelabs`: Bazel-based Saucelabs run (not on PRs — too slow)

Failure notifications for monitoring jobs go to two Slack webhooks: `SLACK_CARETAKER_WEBHOOK_URL` and `SLACK_DEV_INFRA_CI_FAILURES_WEBHOOK_URL` ([config.yml L486–L489](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.circleci/config.yml?L486-L489)).

The CI setup job rebases the PR on the target branch before running any job ([config.yml L227–L229](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.circleci/config.yml?L227-L229)), ensuring tests run against the post-merge state.

Bundle size artifacts from the `test` job are stored and consumed by the Angular Robot's `size` plugin (comment in config at L286–L290).

#### 6. GitHub Actions Workflows

Source: [`.github/workflows/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/tree/.github/workflows)

| Workflow | Trigger | Function |
|---|---|---|
| `merge-ready-status.yml` | `pull_request_target` | Runs `unified-status-check` action; sets `ci/angular: merge status` — the aggregate gate |
| `dev-infra.yml` | `pull_request_target` (opened/sync/reopen) | (1) Applies commit-message-derived labels; (2) runs `post-approval-changes` check |
| `google-internal-tests.yml` | `pull_request_target` | Sets `google-internal-tests` status; uses `google-sync-config.json` to identify files that sync to Google3; triggers Google-internal presubmit requirement |
| `assistant-to-the-branch-manager.yml` | `push` + `pull_request_target` (incl. `labeled`) | Branch management automation |
| `scorecard.yml` | Weekly cron + push to `main` + `branch_protection_rule` | OpenSSF Scorecard — uploads SARIF to GitHub code-scanning |
| `aio-preview-build.yml` / `aio-preview-deploy.yml` | PR events | Builds and deploys a preview of angular.io for documentation PRs |
| `lock-closed.yml` | Scheduled | Locks closed issues/PRs after inactivity |
| `update-events.yml` | Scheduled | Release/update automation |
| `feature-requests.yml` | Issue events | Feature request triage |

All workflow `uses:` action pins include a SHA comment (e.g., `actions/checkout@93ea575cb5d8a053eaa0ac8fa3b40d7e05a33cc8 # tag=v3.1.0`) — supply-chain pinning is universal across workflows.

---

#### 7. Angular Robot (`/.github/angular-robot.yml`)

Source: [`.github/angular-robot.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.github/angular-robot.yml)

**Merge gate** (`merge` plugin): The `action: merge` label activates the merge pipeline. Required preconditions before the label is effective:
- `requireReviews: true` — all requested reviewers must have reviewed.
- `noConflict: true` — no merge conflicts.
- `requiredLabels: ['target: *']` — a target label must be present.
- `forbiddenLabels`: `target: TBD`, `action: cleanup`, `action: review`, `state: blocked`.
- `requiredStatuses`: `ci/circleci: build`, `ci/circleci: lint`, `ci/angular: size`, `google-internal-tests`, `pullapprove`.

**Size plugin**: `maxSizeIncrease: 2000` bytes; sources bundle artifacts from the `ci/circleci: test` job.

**Conflict comment**: auto-comments when a PR has merge conflicts, pinging the PR author.

**Rerun CI**: `action: rerun CI at HEAD` label triggers re-run of the default CircleCI workflow.

---

#### 8. Golden Files (Generated Artifact Checks)

Source: [`goldens/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/tree/goldens), [`goldens/README.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/goldens/README.md)

Three golden categories, each checked in CI and requiring specific reviewer approval:

| Golden | Check command | Update command | PullApprove group |
|---|---|---|---|
| `goldens/public-api/**` | `yarn public-api:check` | `yarn public-api:update` | `public-api` (2 reviewers required) |
| `goldens/circular-deps/packages.json` | `yarn ts-circular-deps:check` | `yarn ts-circular-deps:approve` | `circular-dependencies` group |
| `goldens/size-tracking/**` | Payload size step in `test_aio` / `test_aio_local` | — | `size-tracking` (1 reviewer required) |

The `public-api` and `size-tracking` groups are additionally sequenced — they only activate once no other PullApprove group is pending or rejected, preventing premature golden approval.

The circular-dep golden encodes **known/accepted cycles** as an allowlist (not a prohibition list). Reduction of cycles updates the golden downward; new cycles not in the golden fail CI.

---

#### 9. PR Merge Configuration (`.ng-dev/pull-request.mts`)

Source: [`.ng-dev/pull-request.mts`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.ng-dev/pull-request.mts)

- `githubApiMerge: false` — the ng-dev merge tool uses git-based merging, not the GitHub API squash/merge.
- `requiredBaseCommits`: PRs targeting `main` must be based on commit `5aeb9a4124922d8ac08eb73b8f322905a32b0b3a` (license header update); PRs targeting `10.0.x` must be based on `27b95ba64a5d99757f4042073fd1860e20e3ed24`. This is enforced at merge time.
- `targetLabelExemptScopes: ['dev-infra', 'docs-infra', 'bazel']` — changes scoped to these areas are exempt from patch-branch restriction rules (they can land on patch branches even when they would normally only target `main`).

---

#### 10. Google Internal Sync Gate

Source: [`.ng-dev/google-sync-config.json`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.ng-dev/google-sync-config.json), [`.github/workflows/google-internal-tests.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/angular-angular@27da7338ea8f3bf5336d77ed1877cfa6a1974d52/-/blob/.github/workflows/google-internal-tests.yml)

Files matching `syncedFilePatterns` (`LICENSE`, `modules/benchmarks/**`, `packages/**`) trigger a `google-internal-tests` required status. Files in `alwaysExternalFilePatterns` (tests, BUILD files, zone.js, markdown, etc.) are excluded from that gate even if they are under `packages/**`.

The `google-internal-tests` status is one of the `requiredStatuses` in the Angular Robot merge gate, so any PR touching synced files cannot be merged until a Googler manually runs the internal presubmit (`go/angular/g3sync`).

### B. Observations Specific to the Change at `27da7338`

The `compare_revisions` call between the two stated SHAs (`5ad8231...27da733`) returned zero file differences, meaning this repository mirror does not expose the inter-commit diff for the stated range as a distinct diff. The commit at `27da7338` cannot be independently attributed to a specific PR, revert, or follow-up fix using only the information available in this mirror.

**Deterministic verification queries against the live repository (`angular/angular`)**:

1. **Identify the commit**: `git log --oneline 5ad8231..27da733` — lists all commits in the range; `git show 27da733 --stat` shows the exact files touched.
2. **Which PullApprove groups activated**: given the list of changed files from (1), evaluate each `contains_any_globs` condition in `.pullapprove.yml` against those paths to enumerate required reviewer groups.
3. **Commit type check**: `git show 27da733 --format="%s"` — parse the subject against the type/scope schema in `.ng-dev/commit-message.mts`.
4. **Was it a revert**: `git log --oneline --all --grep="Revert" 5ad8231..27da733` — revert commits would have subject beginning with `revert(scope):` per the Angular commit format.
5. **Golden changes**: `git diff 5ad8231 27da733 -- goldens/` — any golden file diff triggers the sequenced approval groups.
6. **Test file presence**: `git diff 5ad8231 27da733 --name-only | grep '_spec.ts'` — presence of spec files alongside source files.
7. **Required CI statuses passed**: the five statuses listed in `angular-robot.yml` (`ci/circleci: build`, `ci/circleci: lint`, `ci/angular: size`, `google-internal-tests`, `pullapprove`) are recorded on the PR via the GitHub Statuses API and can be retrieved via `gh api repos/angular/angular/commits/27da733/statuses`.
